lines.text: Eleven at night. Forty seven people waiting. Three experts online, all on a call.
Twelve more are offline. Nobody told them.
Supply is fixed. Push demand past it and the queue compounds. At five and a half times, the wait is over an hour.
So it surges by category, and ring fences every dollar to pay the experts who come back online. The response funds itself.
Without it the queue peaks at sixty five and stays there. With it, nine experts accept and the delay halves.
Four hundred and twenty dollars in. Three hundred and eighty out. Net cost, forty dollars.
You cannot surge price a therapist. But you can make sure nobody finds out too late.
